note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the premise text and its status (stated / left unstated) are supplied by the author, never inferred. No conclusion about the reasoning is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional shed key: the fact “The shed key was found in Jo’s coat pocket” and the conclusion “Jo locked the shed last” are pulled apart; the gap reveals the intermediate premise “Whoever holds the shed key locked the shed last”, supplied as LEFT UNSTATED (pencil card, hinges stay folded, it stays in its pocket).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library return where the argument STATES its intermediate premise. The gap reveals a printed card; both brass hinges swing over and latch it into the walk and it lifts flush. Different issue and assumption.

params.facts: The blue umbrella was left at the library desk
params.rules: Items left at the desk go to lost property at closing
params.conclusion: The umbrella went to lost property
issues: Did the desk close at the usual time that day?

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long fact, premise and conclusion texts, long kind labels, two issues, two assumptions, a long analyst name and an editorial annotation.

params.facts: The only key to the garden shed was found in the inside pocket of Jo’s winter coat the next morning
params.rules: Whoever is holding the only shed key the next morning is the person who locked the shed the night before
params.conclusion: Jo is the person who locked the garden shed on the night before the key was found
issues: Who else could have opened or locked the shed that evening without the key?
Was the coat left unattended in the hall overnight?
assumptions: There is only one key and no other way to lock the shed
The coat was not lent to anyone that evening

actorLabels.a: Analyst · reads the argument card by card

annotations.text: The step between fact and conclusion, as supplied

presets.name: baseline-es

params.facts: La llave del cobertizo apareció en el abrigo de Jo
params.rules: Quien tiene la llave cerró el cobertizo el último
params.conclusion: Jo cerró el cobertizo el último
issues: ¿Quién más pudo abrir el cobertizo esa tarde?
